note: M02h5 vegetation scatter (tools/map/src/stages/s13-scatter.ts), run in S13 after the M02h3 cover: Poisson trees and understory shrubs over OSM natural=wood and landuse=forest, groves of trees with edge shrubs on the park cells outside the woods (lawns between groves stay open; leisure=pitch and playground excluded), shrubs over natural=scrub, hedge blocks along barrier=hedge and along a share of yard frontages, sparse yard shrubs; plus the street-tree density rules of S3 (OSM trees near a DataSF tree dropped, a tree every treeRowM along natural=tree_row). Every scatter record carries bit 7 of the TREE byte. Distances in metres, shares 0..1, mixes per form (summing to 1). `seed` is the bake seed of every polygon's stream (fnv32(seed|polyId)). Design values; the OSM tag meanings are recorded in spec/03 section 7. `enabled` false bakes no scatter.
